title: High-volume premium
summary: Qualify only when current volume is strictly above the prior 90th percentile; rank current volume / prior mean volume highest first. Require finite nonnegative past volume, positive mean/current volume and complete close history.
universe: Indian cash equities · current Nifty 500-derived panel

rules.entry: At each completed month-end compare current share volume with its preceding 100 sessions, excluding the signal day. Qualify only when current volume is strictly above the prior 90th percentile; rank current volume / prior mean volume highest first. Require finite nonnegative past volume, positive mean/current volume and complete close history. Select up to 30 stocks monthly; unfilled slots remain cash. No price-momentum or earnings filter.
rules.exit: Sell when removed at a review. No stop-loss or take-profit. Estimate terminal liquidation at final close.
rules.sizing: Up to 30 stocks. Signal equity / 30 per new position; fractional shares; retained positions are not resized.
rules.execution: Rank on a completed session. Sell removals at the next tradable open; buy additions at signal + 3 sessions.

limitations: Long-only high-volume-premium adaptation. Uses historical raw share-volume percentiles and ratio ranking, not shares-outstanding turnover or the paper’s long/short portfolio.
Share-volume corporate-action changes are not independently reconstructed; splits and similar events can affect this signal.
Current Nifty 500-derived universe, not historical constituents: survivorship and selection bias.
2018–2025 influenced parameter selection. The 2026 comparison has been inspected repeatedly; it is not an untouched holdout.
Fractional adjusted shares and normalized starting equity 100; no account-size, market-impact or whole-share constraint.
Current proportional delivery fees applied to all history; fixed DP fees, dividends, delisting proceeds and historical fee changes omitted.
Provider adjustments, retrospective exclusions and terminal-close estimates limit executable interpretation.
